item.title: Campaign Finance Board — Procurement: Agency Consulting
item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
Pursuant to PPB Rule 3-04 (b)(2)(i)(D) of the Procurement Policy board Rules, The Campaign Finance Board (CFB) is proposing a Negotiated Acquisition contract with Jesse Schafer to provide consulting services to counsel the Agency Board, facilitate communication between the Board and CFB staff, and provide administrative support to ensure the Board s adjudicatory and policy-making processes are executed with procedural integrity and in accordance with city-mandated regulations. Contract Term: 3/18/2027 through 3/17/2029. For further opportunities, please visit nyccfb.info/vendors.

item.title: Environmental Protection — Procurement: 82627B0022-BEDC-NR-107: Structural improvements to the North River WRRF
item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
The North River WRRF was originally constructed in 1986, was constructed above the Hudson River with a majority of the structure supported by steel caissons driven into the river soil. Numerous structural elements within the North River WRRF have shown signs of aging and significant degradation. The facility requires repair and upgrades to improve its compliance with DEP s standard operating procedures and to continue to provide reliable wastewater treatment operations in accordance with wastewater treatment regulations. item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
The Agency s current SAN Storage Brocade Switches are no longer under maintenance support, meaning the vendor will not provide software updates, security patches, technical support, or hardware replacements for this model. This situation poses a significant risk and has the potential to impact our business operations, as 100% of the Agency s production environment relies on these Brocade switches. To mitigate this risk, it is crucial for DSS ITS to secure break-fix support to ensure that our mission-critical enterprise applications remain operational.
